hook: Germ granule shape and placement in worm germlines predict an animal's age
summary: In C. elegans, P granules and Mutator foci change in form, position and association with age. Features from single nuclei trained an image-based clock, GG-Clock, that predicts chronological age, and intermittent fasting shifted its output younger. The work is limited to worms, and the open-source GGProfiler tool is not yet shown on other species.
title: Germ Granule Remodeling Reveals Germline Age in Caenorhabditis elegans
